newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police make major arms haul.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police make major arms haul.

text.p: Belgian police made a major haul of illegal arms, ammunition and explosives in a raid on an isolated farmhouse on Thursday night connected to a recent spate of attacks on security vans and banks.
The weapons, put on display by the police on Friday, include assault rifles, machine guns, shotguns, pistols, knives, masks, hundreds of kilogrammes of ammunition and some explosives.
Two people at the farmhouse near the central Belgian town of Nivelles were arrested.
There have been a series of attacks on security vans over the past year all over Belgium involving machine guns and assault rifles with armour-piercing ammunition.
Several people have been wounded and at least one killed.
In December bandits blew up two banks in attempts to get at their hole-in-the-wall money machines -- resulting in one case in a shoot-out with police.
There was another such attack earlier this month.
It is not known how much money the bandits have got away with.
